$schema.title: JSON Schema URI
$schema.description: Versioned URL of the JSON Schema used to validate this record; it must identify the same artifact as schema.ipfs_uri and schema.hash

hash.title: Schema Hash
hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical JSON Schema object identified by this version and IPFS URI

type.title: Collection Schema Type
type.description: Discriminator value identifying this record as a Collection grouping of credits and receipts

version.title: Schema Version
version.description: Version of the schema, using semantic versioning

ipfs_uri.title: Schema IPFS URI
ipfs_uri.description: IPFS URI of the exact pinned JSON Schema artifact whose version and hash are recorded alongside it

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this metadata document was created; it is not the date of the underlying event or methodology publication

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: UUID v4 identifier linking this IPFS record to its counterpart in the Carrot platform and other consuming systems

ipfs_uri.title: Viewer IPFS URI
ipfs_uri.description: IPFS URI of the metadata viewer dApp build

viewer_reference.title: Metadata Viewer Reference
viewer_reference.description: Immutable reference to the metadata viewer dApp build. The IPFS CID itself is the integrity proof: tampered content resolves to a different CID

blockchain_network.title: Blockchain Network
blockchain_network.description: Blockchain network where this record is deployed

deployment.title: Deployment Environment
deployment.description: System environment where this record was generated

data_set_name.title: Data Set Name
data_set_name.description: Name of the data set for this record

name.title: Collection Name
name.description: Human-readable display name for the environmental credit collection

slug.title: Collection Slug
slug.description: URL-friendly identifier for an environmental credit collection, used in URIs and API references

image.title: Collection Image
image.description: IPFS URI pointing to the collection's visual representation

description.title: Collection Description
description.description: Human-readable purpose and context of this collection grouping; this document is distinct from its image asset
examples: Illustrative collection grouping credit purchases and retirements for an example campaign. The collection document describes the grouping and points to a separate image asset; its URI is what receipt collection references cite.

title: Collection IPFS Record
description: Collection metadata stored in IPFS, extending the base schema with collection-specific fields used to group and organize credit purchases and retirements in Carrot's ecosystem
